statistical_interpretation.ENSEssentialCaveat: Both age means above reference; HbA1c residual RMS and total SD below it. Two authors share some evidence and declared age effects.
statistical_interpretation.lipid_essential_caveat: 16/18 negative HDL seed slopes despite6/6 negative means; all18 residual and HDLSD values below sample point. Original B2 ideal-law defect was repaired in both completed R04 branches, with persistent/mixed final analytical discrepancies.
